text:
Noor A.: Heads-up proposal: stabilize resource paths and push transient UI into query params. New left rail groups: Workspaces / Models / Deployments / Observability / Billing. Add a compact breadcrumb strip above page header that is actionable (click to jump) + copy-permalink that returns a server-normalized URL. Also: deep-link preview (small card when pasting) and history coalescing rules. Thoughts? :mag:

Kai M.: Solid. Notes: 1) Back/forward noise if we push every toggle. Rule: replaceState for UI toggles, pushState for explicit navigations (breadcrumb click, open item). 2) Deep-link preview: server should expose an endpoint that returns minimal preview JSON for a canonical URL so link unfurling is small and safe. 3) Canonicalization: server whitelist params and normalize ids (lowercase, strip session tokens).

Isha P.: A11y nits: announce breadcrumb changes via aria-live polite using a short template: "Current location: {workspace}, {section}, {item}". Ensure skip-to-main lands on the active main panel (if right-side drawer is open it should target that panel id). Breadcrumbs must be keyboard operable (Enter/Space activates), last crumb has aria-current="page". Tooltips must be reachable via keyboard (aria-describedby). Do not auto-open flyouts on focus.

DevBot: Reminder: create ticket NAV-501 for server canonicalize endpoint and NAV-502 for history manager spike.

Noor A.: Example canonical URLs: https://console.redwood.ai/w/acme/models?panel=metrics&metric=p95&range=24h and https://console.redwood.ai/w/acme/models/model-zz?revision=12. Shareable params: panel, metric, range, revision. Non-shareable: debug=true, dev_inspect. Deep-link preview endpoint example: GET /permalink/preview?url=<encoded> -> {title, snippet, icon}.

Kai M.: Implementation checklist: router middleware to canonicalize queries on SSR, param whitelist, history manager with coalescing (debounce replaceState for rapid toggles), copy-permalink API that returns canonical URL, deep-link preview service, analytics events (breadcrumb_click, breadcrumb_copy, permalink_open). I'll spike the middleware and small preview lambda.

Isha P.: Keyboard specifics: breadcrumbs inside <nav aria-label="Breadcrumbs">, crumbs as links/buttons, Enter triggers navigation, focus should not automatically jump unless user action implies it. Live-region message should be localizable; provide templates so translators can reorder tokens. Add e2e tests: skiplink lands on active panel, breadcrumb Enter navigates, aria-live announces path, copy-permalink returns canonical URL.

Noor A.: Action items: Kai - spike middleware + preview service (due Mon), Isha - write a11y acceptance tests + live-region templates (due Tue), Noor - spec for copy UX + toast copy variants. Can we try a small pilot on staging next sprint?

DevBot: Pinned: NAV-501, NAV-502, NAV-503 (a11y).
